value.body: A claims executive handles insurance claims from the moment they are filed until they are settled or rejected. Employers include general, health and life insurers, third-party administrators and insurance back-office centres. A typical day involves checking documents, matching them with policy terms, following up on missing papers and updating claim systems.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Com (Banking & Insurance), BBA or any graduate

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Insurers and claims processing centres hire freshers as claims trainees or processing executives, with on-the-job training on policy wordings. Insurance Institute of India exams help with progression.

value.title: At a glance
items: Volume targets and deadlines are common in processing centres.
Next roles: senior claims executive, claims manager, investigation or underwriting roles.
